mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 3.8% over a 3-month period, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 3.8% for 3 months), or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint increase in the federal funds rate and unemployment rate above their respective thresholds (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and UNRATE > 3.7%) signals a tightening monetary policy coinciding with labor market weakness, which compresses corporate profit margins and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and UNRATE > 3.7%, or the interaction term in a regression has a p-value > 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime with high housing starts and slowing GDP growth, the S&P 500 underperforms as the economy approaches a peak. Specifically, when HOUST exceeds 1500 thousand units and GDPC1 annualized growth falls below 1.5%, the market anticipates a slowdown, leading to negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production over the past 3 months indicates strengthening supply chain conditions and rising corporate output, which supports earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO has increased for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to maintain a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as higher rates pressure equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL YoY > 4.0%), or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market recovery regime characterized by accelerating job growth and declining unemployment, the S&P 500 tends to outperform as consumer spending and corporate hiring support economic expansion. Specifically, when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% monthly and UNRATE falls below 3.6%, the market anticipates stronger economic activity, leading to positive 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The simultaneous rise in housing starts and industrial production above their 3-month moving averages indicates synchronized demand and supply strength, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and INDPRO are above their 3-month moving averages, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
